mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.trip_id, e.author_id, e.content, e.intensity, e.advice, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM trip_experiences e JOIN trip_plans t ON t.id = e.trip_id
AND t.destination = #{destination}
AND (
t.tags LIKE ('%"' || #{tag} || '"%')
)
AND LOWER(t.title || ' ' || t.destination || ' ' || e.content || ' ' || e.advice) LIKE ('%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%')
ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC, e.id DESC
